items.title: OSAC operator: Kubeconfig credential-plugin execution and SSRF in console proxy
items.summary: ### Impact The console-proxy's RemoteConfigResolver parses kubeconfig data from Kubernetes Secrets using clientcmd.RESTConfigFromKubeConfig without sanitizing the resulting rest.Config. A kubeconfig containing an exec plugin stanza (under users[].user.exec) is faithfully preserved. When rest.TransportFor later builds the HTTP transport for the upstream WebSocket connection, client-go invokes the exec plugin — spawning an arbitrary process as the osac-console-proxy service account.
